title: Supply Crisis: Pencils!
speaker: Coach
description: The math tournament is in two weeks and our pencil bucket is practically empty!

choices.reaction: The erasers smudge, but the club bank account barely felt a dent.

math_challenge.prompt: Each pencil costs $0.25. How much for all {students} students?

choices.reaction: Kids are clicking furiously with joy! Parents question why we spent that much.

math_challenge.prompt: At $1.75 each for {students} students, what is our total expense?

choices.reaction: Five students forgot pencils. Practice turned into a frustrating search for pens.

title: Fundraiser: Math Bake Sale!
speaker: Parent
description: Parent volunteers offer to run a math-themed pastry sale after school to boost our treasury!

choices.reaction: Huge hit! The smell of warm cookies drew the whole 5th grade hallway.

math_challenge.prompt: Ingredients cost $15. We sell {students_x2} pastries at $3.50 ea. What is Net Profit?

choices.reaction: Modest turnout, but steady sales earned useful pocket money for the club.

math_challenge.prompt: Supply cost $6. We sold {students_x2} cups at $1.50 ea. What is Net Profit?

choices.reaction: Intense practice session, but the treasury remains tight and students are tired.

title: State Math Olympiad Entry
speaker: Coach
description: Registration for the Regional Math Olympiad is due. How many students do we enter?

choices.reaction: Everyone is thrilled to participate! Parents love the inclusivity.

math_challenge.prompt: Registration fee is $8.00 per student for {students} students. Total cost?

choices.reaction: Saves money, but the cut students felt left out and disappointed.

math_challenge.prompt: Half of {students} students go at $8.00 each ({half_students} students). Total cost?

choices.reaction: Fun and free, though missing the official state medals and certificates.

title: Meeting Snacks Dilemma
speaker: Student
description: After a 90-minute geometry session, the mathletes are hungry and losing focus!

choices.reaction: Cheesy goodness revives the room! Morale reaches an all-time peak.

math_challenge.prompt: Pizza costs $2.50 per student for {students} students. What is the total?

choices.reaction: Sensible, salty, and budget-friendly. Nobody is overjoyed, but nobody starves.

math_challenge.prompt: Bulk snacks cost $0.40 per student for {students} students. What is the cost?

choices.reaction: Stomachs grumbled louder than the clock ticking. Productivity tanked.

title: Official Math Club T-Shirts!
speaker: Parent
description: The students want matching 'May The Pi Be With You' shirts for the competition season!

choices.reaction: The team looks so sharp! School spirit is radiating everywhere.

math_challenge.prompt: Shirts are $7.25 each for {students} members. What is our invoice total?

choices.reaction: It took two hours of ironing, but the savings were substantial.

math_challenge.prompt: Badges cost $1.50 each for {students} students. What is the total?

choices.reaction: Disappointment lingered. Other clubs strutted by in flashy jackets.

title: Buzzer System for Math Bowl
speaker: Coach
description: To prepare for speed-round math bowl questions, the coach requests a lock-out buzzer system.

choices.reaction: Practice transformed into a fast-paced game show! Reaction times skyrocketed.

math_challenge.prompt: Vendor offers a 25% educational coupon on a $48 system. What is the discounted price?

choices.reaction: Ding! Ding! It is noisy and low-tech, but gets the job done cleanly.
Constant arguments over who put their hand up first slowed down practice.

title: Guest Speaker: Rocket Scientist
speaker: Coach
description: An aerospace engineer offers to give an interactive hands-on rocketry and geometry demo.

choices.reaction: Incredible presentation! Several students decided on STEM careers on the spot.

math_challenge.prompt: Kits cost $3.50 per student for {students} members. Total investment?

choices.reaction: Interesting slides, though hands-on rocket launches would have been cooler.

title: Fundraiser: 100-Problem Mathathon!
speaker: Student
description: Students seek sponsors to pledge $0.10 for each math challenge problem they solve correctly!

choices.reaction: The community was thrilled to sponsor real math learning! Treasury swells.

math_challenge.prompt: Each student solved 80 problems earning $0.10/problem ($8.00/student). For {students} students minus $8 supplies, what is Net Profit?

choices.reaction: Fast, easy, and raised a tidy sum without weekend overtime.

math_challenge.prompt: {students} students earn $2.00 each ($0.10 x 20). Total revenue?
